findings: MediaStore bucket lookup hashes lowercased paths to 32-bit IDs with no parent-path postfilter in this method; collisions can select unrelated rows. Android bucket semantics not independently qualified.
MediaStore-backed items retain cached size/date rather than fresh file metadata, allowing stale metadata to reach signature-cache validation.
Unindexed image dimensions use ImageLoader Size.ORIGINAL rather than a bounds-only decoder; actual allocation cost unmeasured. Dimension errors still yield a MediaItem with zero dimensions.
deleteMedia returns one aggregate boolean after potentially partial indexed/direct deletion. No deletion API invoked.
moveMedia ignores IDs beyond targetFolders length and requests scans through nested helpers twice. createNewFolder treats any existing destination as success without checking directory type.
